newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK sends home 249 Vietnamese boatpeople.
newsitem.headline: HK sends home 249 Vietnamese boatpeople.

text.p: Hong Kong sent 249 Vietnamese "boatpeople" back to Vietnam on Tuesday as it pressed to clear its refugee camps of rejected asylum seekers ahead of the territory's handover next year.
Most of those repatriated on Tuesday's flights - 99 men, 64 women, 46 boys and 40 girls - had been incarcerated in camps since 1990, the government said in a statement.
The latest repatriation reduced to 7,700 the number of Vietnamese asylum seekers in Hong Kong, a Security Branch spokeswoman said by telephone.
China resumes sovereignty over Hong Kong on July 1 next year and has insisted the British colonial government clear all boat people from the camps before the handover.
The detainees are the last of a huge exodus of people who fled Vietnam after the Communists won the war there in 1975.
